items.title: 31.8 Nuclear energy - fission aur fusion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nuclear and solar energy with Quick Check 31.5 and derived answers (PDF 228-230); the comparison table and fission figure are ours.

blocks.text: Fossil fuels aur environment par un ke nuqsan dene wale asraat parhte hue nuclear energy ke bare mein janna bhi zaruri hai. Nuclear energy aik ummeed afza (promising) zariya hai jo duniya ki barhti hui energy ki zaruratein poori karne mein madad de sakta hai. Nuclear energy woh energy hai jo atom ke nucleus se nikalti hai, ya to jab bhari nuclei toot'te hain (fission) ya jab halke nuclei aapas mein jurte hain (fusion). Yeh reactions chemical reactions ke muqable mein bohat hi zyada energy dete hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: 2011 mein Japan mein bare zalzale (earthquake) aur tsunami ki wajah se Fukushima mein nuclear reactors mein haadse hue. Radioactive cheezein bahar nikalne (leaks) ki wajah se 150,000 se zyada logon ko wahan se nikalna para, aur duniya ko fikr hui ke aafat wale ilaqon (disaster-prone regions) mein nuclear plants kitne mehfooz hain.

Fission woh process hai jis mein uranium-235 ya plutonium-239 jaisa bhari nucleus do halke nuclei mein toot jata hai; is mein energy, neutrons aur radiations paida hoti hain. Nikalne wale neutrons aage aur nuclei ko tor sakte hain; is silsile ko chain reaction kehte hain.
Uranium-235 aur aik neutron ka nuclear reaction yeh hai:

blocks.alt: Aik neutron (n) U-235 nucleus se takrata hai; nucleus Ba-141 aur Kr-92 mein toot'ta hai, '+ energy', aur teen neutrons nikalte hain. Har neutron aage aik aur U-235 nucleus tak jata hai: chain reaction.
blocks.caption: Uranium-235 ka fission aur chain reaction (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.text: Nuclear power plants bijli banane ke liye fission bohat use karte hain. Thore se fuel se bohat zyada energy milti hai, lekin is ki sangeen khamiyan (drawbacks) bhi hain. Is se radioactive waste (kachra) banta hai jise lambe arse tak bohat ehtiyat se sambhalna parta hai. Nuclear haadson ka khatra bhi hai; tareekh mein in ke nataij dekhe ja chuke hain, jaise Chernobyl (1986) aur Fukushima (2011). In haadson ne environment aur insani sehat ko sakht nuqsan pohanchaya.

Solar PV (photovoltaic) system saaf (clean) energy ka system hai. Is ke solar panels aam taur par silicon semiconducting materials se bane hote hain aur photovoltaic effect se dhoop ki energy ko bijli mein badalte hain. Panel par dhoop parne se material ke electrons harkat mein aa jate hain aur direct current (DC) bijli banti hai. Phir inverter is DC ko alternating current (AC) mein badalta hai, jis se ghar, school, offices aur industries chal sakte hain. System mein batteries bhi hoti hain jo raat ya badal wale dinon ke liye bijli jama karti hain, voltage ko stable rakhne mein madad deti hain, aur zarurat par achanak zyada current (surge current) deti hain. Doosri cheezein, jaise electrical accessories, taarein, appliances aur panels ke stand (mounting structures), poore solar system ko achha aur mehfooz banati hain.

blocks.alt: Dhoop (sooraj se surkh teer) solar panel par parti hai. Taar panel se direct current inverter tak, aur inverter se alternating current lightbulb tak le jata hai. Panel ke neeche magnifier excited electrons wali oopar ki tah aur teen tahein dikhata hai: (-) layer, diode aur (+) layer.
blocks.caption: Figure 31.7: Solar panels ka kaam (kitab ki Figure 31.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dhoop silicon ki tahon mein electrons ko excite karti hai; (-) aur (+) tahon ke beech ka diode electrons ko aik hi rukh mein chalata hai, is liye panel direct current (DC) deta hai. Ghar ke aalaat alternating current (AC) par chalte hain, is liye inverter DC ko AC mein badalta hai. Bahut se nizamon mein batteries bhi hoti hain jo raat aur badal ke liye bijli jama karti hain; kitab ki figure mein battery nahi dikhayi gayi.

Solar energy ke purane (traditional) energy sources par kai bare faide hain. Yeh environment dost aur renewable (khatam na hone wala) energy source hai, is liye climate change aur aaloodgi (pollution) ke khilaf larai mein madad deta hai. Solar panels lambe arse mein saste bhi parte hain, kyunke lagne ke baad in ki dekh bhaal (maintenance) kam hai.
Energy ki kami, fuel ki oonchi qeematein aur mausam ke masail batate hain ke hamein solar, hydro (pani) aur wind (hawa) jaise renewable energy sources ki taraf jana chahiye.

blocks.prompt: a) Bohat se solar energy systems mein batteries kyun hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Raat ya badal wale dinon ke liye bijli jama karne ke liye, aur voltage stable rakhne aur surge current dene ke liye.

blocks.prompt: b) Bijli banane ke ilawa nuclear fission aur kahan use hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Maslan kuch submarines aur bahri jahazon ko chalane mein, research reactors mein ilaj (medicine) aur research ke liye radioactive isotopes banane mein, aur nuclear hathiyaron mein.

blocks.prompt: c) Reaction mein ghaib (missing) hissa pehchanein: ²³⁵U + n → ______ + ______ + 3n + energy
blocks.explanation: Barium-141 (¹⁴¹Ba) aur krypton-92 (⁹²Kr), jaisa upar wali equation mein hai. Mass numbers barabar hain: 235 + 1 = 141 + 92 + 3.

blocks.prompt: d) Nuclear reactions chemical reactions se kahin zyada energy kyun dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Nuclear reactions khud nucleus ko badalte hain, jahan bohat taqatwar forces particles ko jore rakhti hain, aur thora sa mass bohat zyada energy ban jata hai. Chemical reactions mein sirf bahar ke electrons ki tarteeb (bonds) badalti hai.

items: Fission: bhari nucleus (U-235) toot'ta hai; neutrons chain reaction chalate hain.
Fission ki khamiyan: radioactive waste, haadson ka khatra (Chernobyl, Fukushima).
Solar PV: silicon panel DC deta hai; inverter AC banata hai; batteries bijli jama karti hain.
